import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
d = df[df.account_id=='sBGaYvw'].copy()
d['date']=pd.to_datetime(d['date'])
pre = d[d.date<'2025-10-20']
post = d[d.date>='2025-10-20']
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    a = pre.groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum()/pre.date.nunique()
    b = post.groupby(col).unblended_cost.sum()/post.date.nunique()
    comp = pd.concat([a,b],axis=1,keys=['pre','post']).fillna(0)
    comp['delta']=comp.post-comp.pre
    print(col)
    print(comp.sort_values('delta',ascending=False).head(8).to_string())
    print()
